title: 芙宁娜 · 雨幕中的落寞独白
description: 细雨落在枫丹廷露台的石雕栏杆上，远处街灯隔着雨幕泛出微弱暖光。芙宁娜身着蓝色礼服，轻靠栏杆，伸出的掌心里积着几滴雨水。她低头看着水面的小小涟漪，另一手扶住湿冷的石面，平日夸张的笑容暂时收起，只剩安静而疲惫的神情。
action: 倚靠枫丹廷露台栏杆，一手接雨滴，一手扶石面，低头凝视掌心。
lighting: cool diffuse rain light with distant warm street lamps
promptProse: On a terrace in the Court of Fontaine, Furina leans against the wet carved balustrade and watches a few raindrops gather in her open palm. Her other hand rests on the stone, steadying her quiet posture in the blue formal coat and small top hat. The public smile has faded into tired, private reflection. Cool rain light softens the terrace while a few warm street lamps blur in the distance. Keep the palm, lowered eyes and stone rail together in a medium portrait.

title: 芙宁娜 · 独奏沙龙午后茶歇
description: 午后阳光穿过沙龙的落地窗，留声机旁的茶桌上摆着草莓蛋糕。芙宁娜戴着黑色贝雷帽，身穿深蓝开衫侧坐在雕花扶手椅上，一手托茶碟，另一手把骨瓷杯停在唇边。她的视线追着茶桌上方轻轻跃动的一只小水形幻灵，忍不住笑了起来，连刚才想好的开场白也忘掉了。
location: 枫丹私人公寓阳光沙龙
action: 侧坐扶手椅，一手托茶碟，一手端杯停在唇边，微笑注视茶桌上方的小水形幻灵。
camera: medium shot, eye level, tea table included
promptProse: A small water spirit bobs above the tea table beside the strawberry cake, drawing Furina into an unguarded smile. She sits sideways in the carved armchair wearing her navy cardigan and black beret. One hand supports the saucer while the other pauses with the iris-patterned cup at her lips. Broad afternoon window light reaches the tiny floating creature, porcelain and nearby gramophone. The spirit is a small nonhuman companion; Furina remains the only person in the salon.

title: 芙宁娜 · 海滨漫步与甜点时光
description: 海滨大道的露天咖啡座上，阳伞流苏随风轻轻摇动。芙宁娜坐在白色铸铁桌旁，黑色贝雷帽压住发梢，深蓝针织开衫的袖口贴在桌边。她一手托着脸颊，另一手举起银色甜点叉，把一小块草莓千层蛋糕送到唇边，尝到奶油后满足地眯起眼睛。
location: 枫丹廷海滨露天咖啡座
action: 坐在白色铸铁桌旁，一手托腮，另一手用银叉品尝草莓千层蛋糕。
lighting: clear morning sunlight and sea reflections
camera: medium shot, eye level, hands and dessert in frame
promptProse: Furina lifts a forkful of strawberry layer cake to her lips at the waterfront cafe, resting her cheek in her free hand. A black beret and navy cardigan replace her stage finery for this relaxed morning break. The silver fork, small plate and white cast-iron table catch reflected light from the sea, while parasol tassels sway above her. Her eyes narrow with simple satisfaction as the cream reaches her tongue. Frame her face and both occupied hands with the sea softly behind.

title: 芙宁娜 · 深夜剧本案头创作
description: 午夜的剧团工作室只亮着一盏绿罩台灯，暖黄的光落在红木桌面与反复修改的剧本上。芙宁娜戴着贝雷帽，披深蓝开衫，一手压住手稿，另一手把羽毛笔杆的末端轻抵唇边，笔尖朝向墨水瓶。她没有急着落笔，而是盯着空白的一行，认真推敲下一句对白。
location: 剧团工作室实木书桌前
action: 坐在剧本桌前，一手压手稿，另一手将羽毛笔杆末端抵在唇边思考，笔尖远离嘴唇。
lighting: warm light from a green-shaded desk lamp
camera: medium shot, slightly high angle, manuscript and face visible
promptProse: The next line remains blank on Furina's theatre manuscript as she considers it beneath a green-shaded desk lamp. Wrapped in her navy cardigan and beret, she holds the blunt end of the quill shaft lightly at her lips, with its inked nib pointing away toward the inkwell. Her other hand keeps the revised pages flat on the mahogany desk. Warm light falls from the green shade onto her concentrated face; the rest of the midnight studio stays quiet and dark.
